name: EL PASEANTE
source:
In the little village of "The Darken Woods",  the folklore says that the spirit of Lil' Dem, known as "The Wanderer", roams through the streets of the village, seeking for a nice chat or a painful vengeance.

Sheriff Elias Carrasco just moved there from the big city, so he doesn't believe in stupid hick folklores.

However, what sheriff Carrasco doesn't know is that "The Wanderer" will sit by his side but...  

WITH WHAT INTENTIONS?

[From [url=https://xptitloupx.itch.io/the-wanderer]Itch.io[/url]]
